judgment_stage: initial image-only frozen judgment; no labels, predictions, reports, previous audit records or other adjudicators judgments read
target: Actual lower-left corner on the bottom edge of each wax block front face. Darker wax remains wax. Ordinary rounded turns remain visible when their side-to-bottom contour is exposed.

Its lower boundary can be followed to the right around y392-394; the darker left margin is not evidence of absence. The nearby dark separator is left of the turn. The rounding and blur broaden placement but do not conceal the corner.
focus_A_rightmost_stack_top_to_bottom.old_point_retention: A previous visible point within this actual rounded-turn neighborhood could be retained on image evidence, not merely convention. A point farther left on the dark separator or higher on the rim would not be supported.

focus_B_partial_fronts_behind_thumb_top_.status: visible and locatable with moderate confidence

focus_B_partial_fronts_behind_thumb_top_.old_point_retention: A previous visible point on the free rounded turn around x461-466,y662-666 is supportable on image evidence, not only an unresolved old convention. A point farther right along the hand intersection would not be supported.

uncertainty_statement: All six decisions are v2. A1-A3 have ordinary rounded/shadowed placement uncertainty; B2 has additional limited-exposure uncertainty but the judgment is that enough of the free lower-left turn is exposed to support v2. No point is assigned merely by projecting a hidden bottom edge. Coordinates are tentative integer placements and not claims of subpixel precision.
methods: Viewed original and in-memory enlarged image crops, including a nearest-neighbor enlargement of the lower thumb-side tip; examined image pixel colors. No model inference or other source files used. Original image and all labels untouched.
